You might spend a morning triaging a networking failure on a system being stood up at a remote site, an afternoon walking a field operator through a sensor calibration over the phone, and the back half of a week hardening a runbook so the next person never has to solve that problem live again. When a fielded system misbehaves, the root cause could be anywhere in the stack--and you're the one who narrows it down. Quality Assurance and Monitoring: Establish and maintain quality metrics for Press Part /Structure components. Monitor supplier performance through regular audits, assessments, and quality control inspections. jobs.title: Videographer, Scout Studios
jobs.description_text: Overview Scout Studios is looking for a versatile Videographer who can move quickly, think visually, and take a story from idea to finish. You'll help own the high-volume brand content pipeline that surrounds Scout's flagship storytelling, adding depth and character to the company’s story by capturing the people, vehicles, events, moments, and stories inside Scout Motors as the company continues to build. One week you may be shooting a walkthrough at the Scout Motors Production Center in Blythewood, SC, the next, producing an experiential event recap, filming a product walkaround, supporting a CRM story, or off-roading in the desert, producing product development and adventure stories. This role will be deeply embedded in the ongoing development of the Scout Motors company, brand, and vehicles, and is poised to own the content work that is quick, nimble, culturally aware, and often the most frequent interaction our audience will have with the Scout brand on our content channels. You'll collaborate with the broader Scout Studios team while working directly with the Head of Scout Studios to develop a content and storytelling pipeline and creative identity of your own. Why Scout Studios Scout Motors and the Scout brand have a rare and special opportunity: we're building the company, the vehicles, the community, and the stories surrounding them from the ground up, at the same time.
